artworks.title: Satan Bound for a Thousand Years
artworks.dimensions:
sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 30 × 21 cm (11 13/16 × 8 1/4 in.)
mount: 40.1 × 33 cm (15 13/16 × 13 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of angels and a dragon. The scene shows an angel in armor restraining a dragon, while another angel observes. The background features a medieval city with castles, churches, towers, turrets, walls, and clouds. This architectural backdrop is densely packed, implying a city of significance. The composition is dramatic, with movement guiding the eye through the celestial figure's interaction with the beast. Swirling clouds add to the drama and mystique, creating a captivating visual narrative.

artworks.title: The Angel Shows Saint John the New Jerusalem
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed within plate mark): 29.9 × 20.4 cm (11 3/4 × 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of intricately designed architectural structures with dynamic figures. The scene includes ornate buildings in the background and powerful figures in the foreground engaged in various activities. There are symbolic elements and a background featuring maritime elements with boats and a coastal settlement.

artworks.title: The Letter "Y"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a warrior figure and a crowned figure in a medieval style. The warrior is depicted on the left, clad in armor with intricate detailing, holding a long spear or pole. At the feet of the warrior is a fantastical creature resembling a dragon. On the right is a figure standing gracefully, crowned and draped in detailed robes, with an angelic figure perched atop.

artworks.title: The Ark of the Lord in the Temple of Dagon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.3 × 41.8 cm (10 3/4 × 16 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several robed figures surrounding a platform with two statues on top. The scene shows various individuals clad in flowing garments, depicted in dynamic poses. In the center, a raised platform holds two statues, one of which appears to be an angelic figure with outstretched wings. The figures are oriented towards the pedestal, some gesturing towards it. The detailed hatching technique creates an intricate play of light and shadow. The artwork captures a moment of dramatic intensity, characterized by the expressive posture and gestures of the figures.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Tombs"
artworks.description: The image shows a large, intricately designed sepulchral monument against a backdrop of dense foliage and architectural elements. The horizon is not distinctly visible, as the monument dominates the scene, with trees and stone structures framing it. The brushstrokes convey a detailed and textured effect, particularly in the rendering of the stone and cloth. The overall color palette is monochromatic, consisting primarily of shades of brown. In the distance are fragments of trees and suggested architectural forms, adding depth and mystery to the image.

artworks.title: Figure Standing under a Stone Arch
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed and atmospheric scene with a grand architectural structure set against a dramatic natural backdrop. The composition is dominated by towering ruins, overgrown foliage, and a central archway with ornate carvings. A veiled figure is positioned on a pedestal behind the archway. Branches and trees blend with the stone structure. The brushstrokes are intricate, capturing textures and details. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, conveying an antique appearance. Trees and rocky outcrops frame the composition.

artworks.title: Tomb with Funerary Urn
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure, possibly a monument or mausoleum, surrounded by dense foliage. The structure is in the center with trees on either side. The perspective is straight-on, displaying the front of the monument. The horizon is hidden by the monument and trees, creating a sense of enclosure. The etching has detailed brushstrokes highlighting the architecture and tree textures. There is a contrast between the structure's geometric lines and the organic curves of the trees. The image is monochromatic using shades of brown and black for depth. Light and shadow enhance the details. The trees frame the structure and draw the eye towards it. The sky has light cloud details for atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows a view looking slightly upward at a crumbling stone bridge with figures crossing it. The horizon is obscured by trees and ruins without a distinct line. The artwork uses hatching and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color palette is limited to brown and sepia shades, typical of aged etchings. architectural details, wild vegetation, and a rugged landscape can be seen.

artworks.title: Interior: Dancing Girls Entertaining Chieftains
artworks.medium: graphite over red chalk on wove paper with commer cially prepared cream ground
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with arches and a group of figures gathered in a space. The scene takes place in a hall with Gothic-style architecture, characterized by columns and arched ceilings. Throughout the composition, figures are rendered, engaged in various activities and adorned in attire suited to the setting. The foreground features objects such as vases, vessels, and platters, suggesting a theme of luxury and abundance. The drawing displays attention to ornamental detail, filling the image with texture and vivacity.

artworks.title: Charles II with His Council
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men in a historical assembly or council meeting. The men are seated and standing in a large room, wearing formal period attire. Some of them are seated around a rectangular table, while others are standing, engaging in conversation or presenting something. The men have bald or nearly bald heads, with formal attire typical of a formal meeting. The room has patterned drapery, wooden paneling, and a high ceiling.

artworks.title: The Vase of the Medici
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a large marble vase decorated with carvings of human figures in classical poses. A person is seen kneeling on the ground, studying or sketching the vase. In the background, there is a tall obelisk and cypress trees. The scene is detailed with etching lines depicting textures of stone, foliage, and fabric. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting the details and shading. The sky is softly rendered with clouds in the distance.

artworks.title: Temple of Antonius and the Campo Vaccino
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with activities in the foreground and a distant horizon. The horizon is high in the image, lined with trees and ruins. In the distance, there are structures, likely Roman ruins, surrounded by vegetation, including cypress trees. The brushstrokes are detailed and precise, typical of etching work, showing architectural and natural details. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to depict texture and form. Closest to us, there are cattle and figures in a rural setting against the backdrop of ancient ruins.

artworks.title: Arch of Constantine
artworks.description: The image shows classical ruins from an oblique angle. There is a detailed façade on the left side and scattered ruins on the right. The horizon is high, with a sky depicted using fine, horizontal lines. In the foreground, there are grazing sheep and a figure. The ruins include carvings and columns on the left and crumbling structures on the right. The image is in monochrome, typical of etchings. The linework captures intricate details of the ruins and landscape, giving the scene a historic quality.

artworks.title: Temple of Concord and Roman Forum
artworks.description: The image features an etching of a classical ruin seen from a slightly elevated perspective. Two large Corinthian columns with intricate capitals stand erect. These columns support fragments of an entablature. Figures are engaged in various activities, including an artist with an easel. Additional buildings and smaller ruins populate the landscape, extending into the distance. The background shows a soft horizon line leading to a sky filled with clouds. The color palette is primarily grayscale, using shading to convey texture and light. The etching technique is evident in the detailed lines and cross-hatching, creating texture and depth.

artworks.title: Two Riders Passing Near a Herd of Animals
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene from a slightly elevated angle. Two men on horseback are surrounded by sheep, next to a textured tree on the right. In the distance, there are rolling hills, clusters of trees, and a small building on a hill. The sky has a few clouds. The etching is black and white with detailed brushstrokes and hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, creating a classic and historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman on Horseback with a Child in Her Arms
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching depicting a pastoral scene. The composition includes a large tree with intricate details on the right side, a group of figures on horseback and with cattle on the left, and rolling hills extending into the distance. The landscape features rocky terrain, hills, and clusters of trees. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: Three Camel Heads
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed etching of three camels captured in bust form from the chest up. The camel in the middle is facing slightly to the left, with its nostrils flaring and pronounced features. On either side, the camels are in profile, facing the center camel. All three camels have intricately detailed fur, emphasizing their shaggy and unkempt coats, especially around the top of their heads resembling a thick mane. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Two Camel Heads
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two camel heads. The drawing depicts the detailed profiles of two camel heads, one on the left and one on the right. The camels are illustrated with a high degree of texture in their fur, using intricate linework to portray the coarseness of their coats and the contours of their features. Each camel's head is turned in different directions. The drawing captures the distinctive facial features and expressions of the camels, with careful attention to their eyes, nostrils, and mouths. The overall effect is a naturalistic yet artistically expressive portrayal that emphasizes the uniqueness of these animals.

artworks.title: Two Horse Heads
artworks.description: The image is an etching of two horse heads positioned side by side in profile. Both horses have detailed facial features, including eyes, noses, and nostrils. The horse on the left has a flowing mane and ears pointed forward, wearing a bridle with circular decorative elements. The horse on the right has a tighter groomed mane with curls at the base. The background is plain and unadorned, with a light border framing the composition.

artworks.title: Three Lion Heads
artworks.description: Three lion heads are depicted in profile facing to the right. The illustrations show only the heads and upper necks of the lions. Each lion's head is detailed with fur strokes accentuating their manes and facial features. The lions display varying expressions. The largest lion's head appears calm, featuring smooth fur and a detailed mane. The middle lion has a more pronounced nose and open mouth. The top left lion has a subtle mane. The background is plain, highlighting the intricate details in the lion illustrations. The artist's signature is in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Jane (Fleming), Countess of Harrington
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The engraving shows a full-length portrait of a woman standing in profile. She is positioned with her body turned slightly to the right, her gaze directed forward, and her head elevated. Her facial features are delicate, with a refined profile and a serene expression. Her hair is styled elaborately, piled high with curls and adorned with a ribbon or decorative piece. She wears a flowing gown with a fitted bodice and voluminous sleeves, cinched at the waist with a sash. A long, sheer fabric drapes elegantly around her arms and cascades down to the ground. In her left hand, she holds a small bouquet or wreath of flowers. The background features a pastoral landscape with dense foliage and trees, open sky with clouds, and a path that leads into a distant landscape.

artworks.title: The Boy with Soap Bubbles (L'enfant aux bulles de savon)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on green paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, positioned slightly to the side with their head turned to the left. They are blowing a bubble using a small pipe held in their right hand. The person has short hair and distinct facial features, though detailed characteristics are somewhat obscured by shading. They are wearing a long-sleeved buttoned shirt with the sleeves seemingly rolled up. In their left hand, they hold a shallow bowl close to their body. The background is a solid dark color, contrasting with the highlights on the person's skin and clothing, highlighting the bubble-blowing activity.

artworks.title: L'agriculture consideree, le Comte de Veaux
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people around a table. Three individuals are seated at the table; the woman in the center has her back facing the viewer, wearing a large hat with a blue ribbon and a green dress. The two men beside her are in period attire. Two men are standing on the right, one in a blue coat and one in a red coat holding a tricorn hat. Another man with white hair and a green coat is observing. A man stands at the head of the table gesturing towards the two young men. In the background, there is a simple wall with a statue in a niche.

artworks.title: A Mameluck Resting
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a seated figure beside a horse. The figure is detailed with a robe and headdress, seated next to a rock and holding a pipe. The horse is equipped with a bridle and carries shields on its back. Palm trees and a distant cityscape are visible in the background. The drawing is monochromatic with shading for contrast.
